main.title: Profile
text: Computer engineering graduate with a strong interest in building complete web products. I have shipped two side projects end-to-end, from database design to deployment. Looking for a junior full-stack role.

items.heading: SplitBill — expense sharing app
bullets: Next.js front end with TypeScript; API routes backed by PostgreSQL via Prisma.
Authentication with OAuth (Google sign-in) and email magic links.
Deployed on Vercel; database on a managed Postgres service.

items.heading: Graduation project: Clinic Appointment System
bullets: Spring Boot REST API and a React client; role-based access for doctors and patients.
Containerised with Docker Compose for the jury demo.

items.heading: Software Intern — Sample Logistics (sample)
bullets: Added filtering and export-to-Excel features to an internal Vue.js dashboard.
Fixed bugs in a Laravel (PHP) backend.
